ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using Iscsicpl - ImageLoad
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the "iscsicpl.exe" UAC bypass technique that leverages a DLL Search Order hijacking technique to load a custom DLL's from temp or a any user controlled location in the users %PATH% Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\iscsicpl\.exe" AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\iscsiexe\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\.*") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*iscsiexe\\\.dll.*")))
